title: AI-Powered CPS-Enabled Vulnerable-User-Aware Urban Transportation Digital Twin: Methods and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2501.10396v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present methods and applications for the development of digital twins (DT) for urban traffic management. While the majority of studies on the DT focus on its ``eyes," which is the emerging sensing and perception like object detection and tracking, what really distinguishes the DT from a traditional simulator lies in its ``brain," the prediction and decision making capabilities of extracting patterns and making informed decisions from what has been seen and perceived. In order to add value to urban transportation management, DTs need to be powered by artificial intelligence and complement with low-latency high-bandwidth sensing and networking technologies, in other words, cyberphysical systems. This paper can be a pointer to help researchers and practitioners identify challenges and opportunities for the development of DTs; a bridge to initiate conversations across disciplines; and a road map to exploiting potentials of DTs f

translated_title: AI驱动、CPS赋能的弱势用户感知型城市交通数字孪生：方法与应用
translated_abstract: 我们提出了用于城市交通管理数字孪生（DT）开发的方法与应用。尽管大多数数字孪生研究聚焦于其“眼睛”，即目标检测与跟踪等新兴的感知与识别技术，但真正使数字孪生区别于传统模拟器的关键在于其“大脑”——即从所见所感中提取模式并做出明智决策的预测与决策能力。为了为城市交通管理创造价值，数字孪生需要由人工智能驱动，并与低延迟、高带宽的传感与网络技术（即信息物理系统，CPS）相辅相成。本文可以作为一个指引，帮助研究人员和从业者识别数字孪生开发中的挑战与机遇；作为一座桥梁，促进跨学科之间的交流对话；同时作为一张路线图，用于挖掘数字孪生的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出了由人工智能驱动、信息物理系统（CPS）赋能、关注弱势交通使用者的城市交通数字孪生的方法与应用框架，并强调数字孪生的核心价值在于具备预测与决策能力的“大脑”，而不仅仅是感知层面的“眼睛”。
en_tdlr: This paper presents methods and applications for an AI-powered, CPS-enabled, vulnerable-user-aware urban transportation digital twin, emphasizing that a digital twin's core value lies in its "brain"—prediction and decision-making capabilities—rather than merely its "eyes" of sensing and perception.
